messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 5 April
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system will be unavailable from 20:00 to 23:00 on Saturday 5 April for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close any open documents before this window. No action is required.

IT Helpdesk, Whitfield Carter LLP
